name: io.github.sudo-ai-git/mcp-secret-scrub
description: Deterministic no-LLM MCP server that scrubs secrets before they reach an agent. Never leaks values.
author: sudo-ai-git

metadata.description: Deterministic no-LLM MCP server that scrubs secrets from text before they reach an agent. Redact/mask/hash, never leaks the value.
metadata.author: sudo-ai-git
metadata.longDescription:
Scrubs AWS/GitHub/AI-provider tokens, JWTs, PEM private keys, Bearer tokens, connection strings and api_key= assignments from arbitrary text before it is logged, stored, or handed to an agent. Deterministic, no LLM, no network, MIT.

Tools: scrub_text(text, mode, keep_label), scan_text(text), report_full(text), secret_profiles().
